summary.text: Guilds of Ravnica takes place on Ravnica as the story gears up for a final showdown with Nicol Bolas, who is trying to slowly influence and warp the plane.

It follows guild leaders and planeswalkers such as Vraska, who becomes Golgari leader and kills Isperia after Bolas rewards her, and Ral Zarek, who is appointed acting Izzet guildleader and turns an Izzet project into a beacon to call planeswalkers against Bolas.
The guilds' cooperation collapses with Isperia's death, and Bolas activates the Immortal Sun, trapping planeswalkers on Ravnica.
